subject: Insights platform license alignment — Amplitude / Mixpanel coverage and bids
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Insights platform license alignment — Amplitude / Mixpanel coverage and bids

Hi team,

Our contracts for product analytics (Amplitude) and exploratory telemetry (Mixpanel) are coming up for renewal in Q3. I pulled a quick usage snapshot (attached) — event volumes skewed toward API ingestion for mobile + integrations, and a growing number of seats for product analytics.

Goals for this thread:
- Align coverage needs across product/infra (what events and retention matter)
- Decide whether we consolidate on one vendor or maintain both with different scopes
- Request updated proposals and cross-check pricing bands (usage + seats + retention)

Can each of you reply with:
1) your prioritized requirements (retention, event types, peak ingest needs)
2) any non-negotiables for SLA / data residency / audit logs
3) preferences for consolidation vs. split (and why)

I'll reach out to vendor reps this week to ask for refreshed bids and incremental discounts tied to committed volume.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex Martinez
Head of Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Insights platform license alignment — Amplitude / Mixpanel coverage and bids

Alex — quick thoughts from Product/Analytics ops: 

1) Priorities:
- 12+ month raw event retention for feature telemetry (we replay queries for regressions)
- Low-latency funnel calculations for live experiment dashboards (sub-5s ingest-to-query for key metrics)
- Cohort exports (CSV / S3) for downstream ML training pipelines

2) Non-negotiables:
- SOC2 / ISO evidence and access to audit logs during renewal window
- Right to export full event streams on-demand; no vendor lock on keys

3) Consolidation preference:
- Lean toward a split approach: Amplitude for canonical product analytics and experimentation, Mixpanel for ad-hoc exploratory queries and lower-cost long-tail storage. Mixing reduces vendor lock and gives insurance.

I'll attach detailed event list to the shared Drive doc (link in metadata) — happy to take point on scoping event tiers.

-Laura

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Analytics | Redwood Inference

Hi Alex / Laura — thanks for the note and usage file.

Attached is our refreshed proposal (amplitude_proposal_v2.pdf). Highlights:
- Committed events pricing tier aligned to your Q2 volumes with a 15% discount for a 12-month commit, 22% for 24-month commit.
- Added a data retention addon (12 -> 24 months) and a separate cold-storage export rate.
- SLA: 99.9% query availability for production dashboards; expanded audit log access included in enterprise plan.

A couple of clarifying questions from our side:
- Do you plan to retain full raw event streams or rely on sample/ingestion rules?
- For funnel latency, can you share target queries per minute during experiments?

If helpful, I can set up a 30-min pricing walk-through early next week.

Date: 2027-05-06T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Insights platform license alignment — negotiation support offer

Hi all — Ari here (copied per Alex's earlier note). I reviewed the usage CSV and Amplitude's baseline. Quick take:

- You have predictable steady-state event volume plus occasional spikes. We recommend negotiating a cap+overage construct rather than pure elastic pay-as-you-go; that usually gives the best blended unit price while keeping flexibility for spikes.
- Ask for a clause to annualize usage tiers with a one-time re-banding mid-year if growth >40% to avoid surprise overages.
- For Mixpanel, the value is lower TCO for exploratory queries; push for a cross-sell discount if you commit canonical tracking to Amplitude (vendors often accept a modest credit to stay in both stacks).

I'll draft negotiation bullets and a concession matrix if you want — can do a 45-min call Thursday to align and role-play.

Best,
Ari Kapoor
Principal, Ari Consulting
